Due to health and safety reasons we cannot accept the return of this product unless all petrol and oil have been drained (your statutory rights are not affected).

Powered by a Mountfield ST120 OHV 123cc engine and features a tough, corrosion-free polypropylene cutter deck. Lightweight, easy to use and economical to run. Includes 4 height adjusters with 5 pre-set cutting positions ranging from 25-70mm. Can also be used without the collector to leave the cuttings. Suitable for lawns up to 400m². This product requires 4-stroke oil (not included).
b: 2 Year Manufacturer’s Guarantee (Registration Required, T&Cs Apply)
